themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can perform research tasks autonomously or with minimal human input, including exploration, data gathering, and analysis.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that assist developers with writing, debugging, refactoring, and understanding code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Highlights AI-powered platforms and tools designed to enhance or automate various aspects of the research process, from discovery to analysis.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Examines the capabilities, limitations, risks, and user interactions related to AI chatbots in various contexts.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Discusses the comparison, benchmarking, and assessment of different AI tools and models for specific applications and effectiveness.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Explores how AI is being used to inform product strategy, understand user needs, and improve product development.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Covers the use of AI to analyze and understand user sentiment, feedback, and opinions from various sources.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Focuses on integrated platforms that leverage AI to streamline and support multiple research activities.

themes.name: AI qualitative research
themes.description: Details the application of AI in qualitative research methods, such as interviews and thematic analysis.

themes.name: AI recruitment research
themes.description: Investigates the impact of AI on employment, job markets, and the skills required for the future workforce.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
